$comment: Single source of truth for pipeline order. Rules run in ascending `order`. Disabling a rule removes it from the sequence and never reorders the rest. Rule ids are public API (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 5).

rules.summary: Collapse repeated spaces, strip spaces before punctuation, normalize spacing inside brackets.
Three dots to U+2026; locale-dependent abbreviated forms after terminal punctuation.
Parenthetical dash and numeric/date range dash per locale convention.

Bind morphological hyphen forms with U+2011 (non-breaking hyphen) so they cannot be broken across lines. Runs after `dashes`, which has already declined every letter-adjacent hyphen. A no-op for locales whose hyphen lists are empty.
Straight quotes to locale primary/secondary pairs with nesting resolution. Runs before `apostrophe` so that a straight apostrophe is still available as quote evidence.
Remaining straight apostrophes to U+2019 without corrupting contractions.
(c)/(r)/(tm) to the corresponding signs; multiplication sign between numerals.
Insert no-break and narrow no-break spaces per locale. Runs last so that every other rule has already settled the surrounding characters.
